title: A bill to designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 1106 Main Street in Bastrop, Texas, as the "Sergeant Major Billy D. Waugh Post Office".
official_summary: This act designates the facility of the U.S. Postal Service located at 1106 Main Street in Bastrop, Texas, as the Sergeant Major Billy D. Waugh Post Office.

summary.headline: A federal law renames a Postal Service building in Bastrop, Texas, after Sergeant Major Billy D. Waugh.
summary.what_it_does: This act names the U.S. Postal Service facility at 1106 Main Street in Bastrop, Texas, the Sergeant Major Billy D. Waugh Post Office. It changes only the official name of the building. It does not change postal services, hours, or rules.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 23, 2024, and the designation took effect on that date.
